async_explorer.assessment: Not selected as a direct replacement for current Ratatui 0.30.2 integration. It provides real tokio filesystem IO and timeouts, but host scheduling is still required for interactive loading; the default backend converts native paths to lossy Strings and has a delete operation. A compatibility port was not built or tested.

highlighting.assessment: Independent compiled probe passed Ratatui 0.30.2 Line compatibility, exact Unicode/space/tab content, multiline parse state, semantic colors and common grammars. Caller retains per-line/message limits and normalizes CRLF/control display. Application integration remains pending.
highlighting.alternative_limit: Latest tree-sitter-highlight 0.27.0 requires Rust 1.90; this does not claim older tree-sitter versions are unusable.
